testcase.name: Scenario: Open a different drawing by double-clicking its row: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-document-opening-source/features/application/document-opening/document-opening.feature:239:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open a different drawing by double-clicking its row ✔ Given writable copies of `fixtures/cad/document-opening/OpenDrawingA.odd`, `OpenDrawingB.odd` and `OpenPart.opd` are staged in the same working folder ✔ And the user opens each drawing, inserts a base view referencing the staged OpenPart.opd, saves it and closes it ✔ Given an assembly document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Open dialog displays two saved drawings in a folder ✔ And the first drawing is selected ✔ And the second drawing has a sheet, border and saved views and is not already open ✔ And `fixtures/cad/single-occurrence.oad` is active and `OpenDrawingA.odd` plus `OpenDrawingB.odd` are closed ✔ When the user double-clicks the second drawing's row ✔ Then the Open dialog closes ✔ And the second drawing opens in a new active document tab ✔ And its sheet, border and saved views are displayed ✔ And the assembly tab remains available
